evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable `-Wunused` and related compiler warning flags across the build configuration.
rationale: Enabling `-Wunused` helps prevent dead or mistakenly omitted code from accumulating in the codebase. As noted in the PR description, recent work has included 'an instance of what was thought to be dead code, but it'd actually just been forgotten to be used: #36137.'
